misappropriates or converts to his own use any movable property, shall be punished
with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend two years, or
with fine, or with both."
As per the explanation thereto, a dishonest misappropriation for a time only is a misappropriation

material to proceed against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Section 403 of I.P.C. but not for the offence punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of I.P.C. The ends of justice are higher
than the ends of mere law though justice has got to be administered according to laws
